rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for something or someone seen as unfashionably old-fashioned, often with a mildly negative tone.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou5 tou2

rows.note: Use this for an object, style, or idea that is no longer current or in vogue.

example.english: This kind of design is already old-fashioned.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 cit3 gai3 ji5 ging1 gwo3 si4 laa3

rows.note: Choose this for a person or their habits when they cling to traditional customs rather than simply looking unfashionable.

example.english: My grandma is still very old-fashioned, insisting that the whole family eat reunion dinner together at New Year.
example.traditional: 我阿婆仲係好守舊，堅持過年一定要全家食團年飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 po4 zung6 hai6 hou2 sau2 gau6 gin1 ci4 gwo3 nin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 cyun4 gaa1 sik6 tyun4 nin4 faan6
